transcript: Write a docstring for this function that explains what it returns and what happens when the input list is empty. Keep it short and use Google style.
I'm away until January 6th. Please contact Priya Raman at priya.raman@northwind.io for anything urgent.
I'm on the checkout-v2-feature branch. How do I undo my last three git commits but keep the changes staged?

I need a quick variance explanation for the October budget report. Marketing spent 62,000 against a budget of 58,000, so we're over by 4,000. Most of it was the trade show in Austin. Write two or three sentences I can drop into the report for the CFO and keep it neutral.

In billing.ts, the calculateProratedAmount function returns NaN whenever a subscription starts on the 31st, and I'm pretty sure it's the date math on plan.start_date. Can you rewrite it with date-fns and add a unit test that goes from January 31st to February 28th? We're on date-fns version 3, so don't use the old imports.
The unit tests for the invoice parser started failing after I merged Priya's branch. Can you figure out which of her changes broke them and explain why?
Pull the hardcoded feature flags out of the checkout page and read them from the config service like we do everywhere else.
For the comment form, trim the whitespace, block empty submissions, disable the button while it's posting, and clear the field when it succeeds.
Look at the flaky upload tests, the one that times out on CI. Figure out why and fix it, and then run it a bunch of times in a row so we know it's actually stable.

Look at the Swift crash report I dropped in the chat. It's crashing in the feed view controller when the user scrolls really fast, and it looks like an index out of range.

This started in build 4.3 when we added the prefetching. Can you find where we're reading from the array after it's been reloaded and make that safe? Don't rewrite the whole data source, just fix the race.
Move the budget section above the timeline.
Closing line for the newsletter: As always, if you have a story idea or just want to say hi, reply to this email and it'll come straight to me.

Agenda for the parent volunteer meeting:
- Introductions
- Review last year's fall festival
- Assign booth leads
- Open floor for questions at the end

- 1 can of condensed milk
